caloocan.info: Caloocan is a historic city known as the 'Home of the Katipunan'. It played a crucial role during the Philippine Revolution.

heritage_spots.name: Monumento (Bonifacio Monument)
heritage_spots.info: An iconic 45-foot pylon designed by Guillermo Tolentino commemorating Andres Bonifacio.

heritage_spots.name: San Roque Cathedral
heritage_spots.info: Established in 1815, it served as a spiritual center during the Spanish colonial period.

heritage_spots.name: Tandang Sora Birthplace
heritage_spots.info: The site where Melchora Aquino, the 'Mother of the Katipunan', was born.

caloocan.tips: Visit Monumento at night to see the lighting; it's perfect for photography.
caloocan.directions_template: From {user_loc}, take the LRT-1 to Monumento Station or a jeepney passing through McArthur Highway.

malabon.info: A coastal city rich in heritage houses and 17th-century architecture, often called the 'Venice of the Philippines'.

heritage_spots.name: San Bartolome Church
heritage_spots.info: Built in 1614, this Greco-Roman church is a masterpiece of Spanish colonial engineering.

heritage_spots.name: Raymundo Ancestral House
heritage_spots.info: The oldest documented heritage house in Malabon, built in 1861 with a distinct 'Bahay-na-Bato' style.

heritage_spots.name: Angel Cacnio Art Gallery
heritage_spots.info: Home to the works of a Master Painter; a hub for Malabon's local art scene.

malabon.tips: Try the Tricycle Heritage Tour for an easy way to see all these spots in one go.
malabon.directions_template: From {user_loc}, take a jeepney to Sangandaan, then transfer to a 'Malabon-Hulo' jeepney.

navotas.info: The 'Fishing Capital', Navotas holds maritime secrets and centennial religious sites.

heritage_spots.name: San Jose de Navotas Parish
heritage_spots.info: Established in 1859, it stands as a witness to the city's transformation from a fishing village to a city.

heritage_spots.name: Navotas Fisheries Port
heritage_spots.info: While industrial, it is the historical heart of the city's identity since the 1900s.

navotas.tips: Visit during the Bangus Festival (May) to see the traditional coastal celebrations.
navotas.directions_template: From {user_loc}, take a jeepney labeled 'Agora' or 'Navotas' passing through C4 road.

valenzuela.info: The 'Vibrant City', home of Dr. Pio Valenzuela.

local_routes.wawang_pulo_to_museo: Since malapit ka lang, take a jeep bound for 'Polo' or 'Malanday'. Baba ka sa Polo Church, walking distance na lang ang Museo.
local_routes.karuhatan: Take any jeep going North (Malanday). Baba sa Gen. T. De Leon or Malanday, then transfer to a Polo-bound jeep.

heritage_spots.name: Museo ni Dr. Pio Valenzuela
heritage_spots.info: The restored ancestral home of the Katipunan hero, showcasing artifacts and personal memorabilia.

heritage_spots.name: San Diego de Alcala Church
heritage_spots.info: A 17th-century church with a stone belfry that survived WWII.

heritage_spots.name: Arkong Bato
heritage_spots.info: Built in 1910, this stone arch marks the boundary between Bulacan and Rizal.

heritage_spots.name: Arkong Bato Park
heritage_spots.info: A landscaped heritage site featuring the monument of Katipunan hero Captain Delfin Velilla.

heritage_spots.name: Polo Park
heritage_spots.info: A vibrant 2,500-square-meter plaza featuring a memorial to WWII local residents.

heritage_spots.name: Valenzuela City People's Park
heritage_spots.info: A 1.5-hectare urban green space in Karuhatan beside the City Hall.

heritage_spots.name: Valenzuela City Family Park
heritage_spots.info: A nature-centric space preserving over 30 varieties of century-old trees.

valenzuela.tips: Drop by the Polo Riverwalk nearby after visiting the Museum for a quiet sunset view.
valenzuela.directions_template: From {user_loc}, take a jeepney to Malanday, then a tricycle or jeep to Polo Church/Museum.
